reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed — the rendered paragraphs are identical to the originals, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: p0023 is a pure revenue-share pointing to Exhibits with no 'no less favourable', benchmarking or price-matching language, and p0001 expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves Customer's right to use other agents — the opposite of an MFN burden on Customer.

Direction test satisfied: no MFN obligation runs against the Customer (AP), so the clause set sits at the preferred position; the file note flagging Exhibits/amendments for possible 'most favourable rates' undertakings is an appropriate rationale-level caveat rather than a flagged deviation.
